finding.title: The `recvfrom` function is used to receive data into a fixed-size buffer (`sizeof(uint32_t)`), but there is no check to ensure that the received data does not exceed this size.
The code does not sanitize user input before using it in the `scanf` function.
The code does not validate the input received from the client.
The code does not handle errors when reading input from the user.
The code does not log any information about the client or the data received.

scan_orig.message: Check buffer boundaries if used in a loop including recursive loops (CWE-120, CWE-20).
Avoid using 'scanf()'. This function, when used improperly, does not consider buffer boundaries and can lead to buffer overflows. Use 'fgets()' instead for reading input.
